svg.title: From three anchor points to two rotations
svg.desc: Circle through P0=(0,0.05), P1=(2α,1.0), P2=(5α,0.45) with α=0.32: centre (0.8145,0.1918), radius 0.8268; sweeps -1.5305 and -1.4659 rad are twice the inscribed angles 0.7652 and 0.7330; rates -0.7652 and -0.4886 rad per sample.
svg.text: Time: equal angles give two rotations
Aqua dots: steps of ½ sample in time = equal angle steps on each side.
